questions.answer:
import json
def active_emails(raw):
    data = json.loads(raw)
    return [u['email'] for u in data.get('users', []) if u.get('is_active')]
print(active_emails(raw))

questions.answer: Single quotes are invalid JSON (requires double quotes) so `loads` raises `json.JSONDecodeError`. Fix the payload to use double quotes.

questions.answer: datetime, set, and custom objects are not JSON serializable by default and raise TypeError. Convert to string first, e.g. `.isoformat()` or `default=str`.
